method: Fresh production frontend build; real backend at each exact commit through repository scripts/run_dashboard_browser_smoke.py --backend-fd. Direct synthetic SQLite seeding using AccountsRepository and UsageRepository. Chromium renders real local dashboard/API without response interception or mocking; network namespace prevents outbound traffic.
limitations: Focused dashboard visualization of the conservative capacity floor, not a provider quota measurement.
Uses the repository browser-smoke harness, which disables background schedulers in process; it does not exercise provider refresh or real account authentication.
Does not replace the prior routing tests or pending upstream CI/maintainer review.
